'''Rob Burns''' was the key 3D artist on the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules" /> The SWCCG card [[Bron Burs]] is an anagram of his name.<ref name="ana">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], geocities.ws. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012174750/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Internet Archive]</ref> The anagram list tags the card UGLY, pairing it with the ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly'' in-jokes [[Debnoli]] and [[Gela Yeens]].<ref name="ana" />

== Anagrams ==

* [[Bron Burs]] — Rob Burns, artist; ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly''

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Burns built many of the game's main 3D models.<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010224092942/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Internet Archive]</ref>
